content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

The alternatives to Gumroad and Payhip for restricted countries include Lemon Squeezy, Paddle, and self-hosted solutions like Shopify or WooCommerce. Lemon Squeezy, for instance, charges a 3.5% + $0.30 per transaction fee and operates in 30 countries. Paddle, on the other hand, offers a more advanced featureset, including a 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction fee, but only operates in 14 countries. Self-hosted solutions like Shopify or WooCommerce require manual payment setup and often come with additional costs for customization and maintenance.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Payhip, and Lemon Squeezy restrict access to certain countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. PayPal also restricts access to these countries, and a PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed in 48 hours and operate in 195+ countries, making them the go-to choice for digital creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
